what: While the frame is more than half visible on screen, moving the cursor anywhere in the document makes the video or photo, laid out 40px wider on each side and 20px taller top and bottom than the frame, follow by (cursor − frame center) × .03 through a damped spring (stiffness 200 · damping 40 — no overshoot, settles in about .3s). Sweeping edge to edge on a 1440 screen gives ±21px — the full-screen video seems to breathe and follow slightly. When the frame leaves view it returns to 0.

options.strength: Strength multiplied by cursor distance, default .03
options.--fx-bleed-x · --fx-bleed-y: (css variable) distance the image overflows the cell, default 40px · 20px — must be larger than strength × half cell width
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Image being pushed — if none, the element itself is pushed

from.where: index.html .fh-room__media (original code component: useSpring({damping:40, stiffness:200}) gets (clientX − center) × .03, video 1520×940 · IntersectionObserver .5 · off on touch and 768 or below)

note: Nothing is applied on handless devices (hover false) or with reduced motion.
